project_description: AXIS Design System - React 컴포넌트 라이브러리 및 디자인 토큰

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+commit' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm type-check >&2 || exit 1

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */packages/axis-*/src/*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; d=${f#*/packages/}; d=${d%%/*}; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && n=$(jq -r '.name // empty' "packages/$d/package.json") && [ -n "$n" ] && pnpm turbo run type-check --filter="$n" >&2 || exit 1
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */packages/*/registry/registry.json) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm build:registry >&2 || exit 1
